test_title: PYST 54: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 22 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

He had always liked this mosque, it was gracious, and the arrangement ________ him.
solution:
The correct answer is ** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In this context, the arrangement of the mosque is something the subject has always liked.
 
• The word **‘pleased**’ fits best because i**t conveys contentment that matches the subject ’s sentiment.**

Hence, the correct statement is "***He had always liked this mosque, it was gracious, and the arrangement pleased __him."***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Other options like 'dissatisfied,' 'bothered,' or 'happy' do not logically fit the context as contentment.

 
• The surrounding words and sentence context suggest a positive emotion about the mosque and its arrangement.
 
• 'Pleased' fits this positive context logically and syntactically better than other choices.
